title: Input
description: Settings for how you type during practice.

simpleSpecial.heading: Simple special-character input
simpleSpecial.description: Lets you type letters with accents, tildes and other marks — like í, ó, ñ and č in Czech or Spanish — with the plain letter (i, o, n, c). Typing the marked letter itself is still correct.
simpleSpecial.label: Use simple special-character input
simpleSpecial.hint: When on, special characters such as á and č count as correct when you type a and c.
simpleSpecial.note: This setting is saved in this browser.
simpleSpecial.unsaved: The setting can't be saved, so it applies only while this page is open.
